nativeContract.observation: The existing SourceEntry does not need an additional display field for this case. Source-specific composition of actual parent and season names belongs to the TMDB adapter; ordinary name evidence remains distinct from identity proof and arbitrary presentation processing.

findings.search: Multi search returns movie, TV and person objects, not season objects. An anime search can internally use TV hits to read standard seasons while emitting only Movie and Season candidates.
findings.seasonName: The official season-detail example names the object Season 1. A raw season label alone can be insufficient to distinguish candidates from different TV parents.
findings.seasonFields: Season details and translations supply actual name/overview/date, posters, episodes and networks. The season image endpoint returns posters, not season-specific backdrop or title-logo collections.
findings.range: TV remains read context only; no source entry, work binding or implicit identity equivalence is introduced.

changesApplied: SourceEntry fields remain unchanged. Formal provider wording now distinguishes source-context name mapping from query text, UI decoration and processor output. The TMDB extension owns one full-name rule reused by search, resolve and name reads.

confirmedRules.search: Reuse the existing anime Entry search method. Filter applicable Movie results, expand applicable TV hits into actual standard-season candidates, preserve bounded pagination and never return selectable TV or episode-group targets.
confirmedRules.nameMapping: The TMDB extension composes a complete season name from actual parent-title and season-name facts, and reuses that rule in search identification, resolve and requested name reads. No query text, decorative UI text or processor-generated name becomes source evidence.
confirmedRules.correspondence: The resulting name is a weak name clue subject to existing scope, uniqueness and conflict rules; full season identity remains unchanged and the parent TV is not an equivalent work identity.
confirmedRules.seasonFields: Use actual season-scoped fields and credits. Name composition does not permit inheritance of missing season overview, images, production companies, release state or total runtime from the parent TV record.
